# From a later dump onto existing specs

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

Use this when **specs already exist** under `docs/specs/` and there is a **new dump** (notes, tickets, old docs, diagrams, screenshots) to sort onto them.

A not-started spec (match status `not in the code`, or a thin spec) can keep taking information until planning. Adding information does not start planning and does not write `plan.md` or `tasks.md`.

## First prompt

`@` the dump.

```text
/crav1-add-to-spec
@notes/later-dump.md
@tickets/
@sketches/flow.png

The specs already exist. Sort this dump onto them.
Do not write code. Do not plan.
```

Write `/crav1-add-to-spec mail` or `/crav1-add-to-spec chat`, or just say "add this mail to the spec": the word, or "this mail", "this email" or "this chat" in the message, skips the opening question. A mail is always an imported source and is stored under `docs/sources/` first. A mail or chat that shows an open question being asked gives that question its `Asked:` date from the source.

## Steps

| Phase | You | Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Specs | — | Reads `docs/specs/<slug>/` (skips `_template`). Does not ask for a slug. A hint in the dump that names a slug is evidence for the sort |
| Sort | Confirm or edit the piles | Belongs to this spec, already in that spec, or does not fit any of them. What fits nothing stays in the full note |
| Write | — | Quotes the new bits into the matching `spec.md` files. The whole dump is written once as one full note in `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/`. Labels what is new versus what was already there. Inferred stays inferred. Does not invent acceptance, architecture, or tasks. Does not commit |
| Impact | If other files are affected, pick apply or leave them alone | Reads `docs/system/` and the other specs. Lists each proposed edit in one line. Does not edit those files until apply |
| Stop | Glance, then `/crav1-finalize-commit` if a changed file should be in git | Does not plan, implement, or commit |

No spec folders under `docs/specs/` (other than `_template`): the command stops and points at spark, ideas, intake, or match.

The card is `yes (Recommended)` to write it as shown, or typed changes on that card's free-text answer. It does not say `table above` unless that table is in the reply.

## What gets written

The matching `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md` files, for bits that were new.

the whole dump is one full note, `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md`, filed by the date the dump shows (no date: the import date, and it says so). Each belongs quote links it as `Full source:`.

A mail, a transcript, a chat, a screenshot, or another original that a confirmed quote comes from is also written under `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`. The spec `Source:` and `Trace:` lines link to that folder.

Other `docs/system/` files and other specs change only when apply is picked.

No `plan.md`. No `tasks.md`. A missing `docs/system/` is not seeded here. A missing `glossary.md` is a gap fill only when `docs/system/` already exists. A meaning the dump does not state is `to be researched`. When `docs/system/` already exists, that same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect.

## After

When a Conflict line was written, `Next` is `/crav1-resolve-open-questions` for that slug, because the conflict is unsettled. Otherwise, when an existing spec changed, `Next` is `/crav1-tighten-spec`, because the new information is not tightened yet. When a file changed and is not committed, the run adds an Uncommitted line for `/crav1-finalize-commit`.
